query: UPDATE decision_engines SET document=$2,version=$3,last_set_by='seed',seed_digest=$4,seed_state='current',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,budget_since=CASE WHEN document->'budget' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2::jsonb->'budget' THEN budget_since WHEN $2::jsonb ? 'budget' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END WHERE name=$1
